notes.title: Update v1.1.3
notes.notes:
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 1 more way to discover [spoiler]Cat[/spoiler].

[b]FIX:[/b] Fixed an issue where dragging an element from the categories to the right would cause the entire game layout to move to the left.

notes.title: Update v1.1.2
notes.notes:
[b]NEW:[/b] You can now see a green checkmark on the element when it no longer has possible combinations.
[b]NEW:[/b] A console message was added to indicate when an element no longer has possible combinations.
[b]NEW:[/b] A "Main menu" button was added in the top right corner of the screen.
[b]NEW:[/b] Now the changelog window is displayed for each version update.

[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 3 more ways to discover [spoiler]Petroleum[/spoiler].
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 1 more way to discover [spoiler]Beef[/spoiler].
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 1 more way to discover [spoiler]Pork[/spoiler].
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Maximum console messages were increased from 200 to 500.

[b]FIX:[/b] Fixed an issue that displayed the resolution incorrectly in the monitor dropdown menu when the monitor had a scale higher than 100%.
[b]FIX:[/b] Minor UI fixes.

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]NEW:[/b] Now you can right-click an element in the sidebar to see its preview and combination.
[b]NEW:[/b] Now the number of discovered and total elements in each category is displayed.
[b]NEW:[/b] Added 11 new common elements (from 204 to 215):
[list]
[*] Objects: 5
[*] Animals: 4
[*] Space: 2
[/list]
[b]NEW:[/b] Added 3 new special elements (from 16 to 19).
[b]NEW:[/b] Added 4 new achievements (from 32 to 36).
[b]CHANGE:[/b] 2 elements have been reworked: [spoiler]Wheel[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Windmill[/spoiler].
[list]
[*] If you have already unlocked [spoiler]Wheel[/spoiler], perform the combination again to unlock a new element.
[/list]
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 2 more ways to discover [spoiler]Bird[/spoiler].
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 1 more way to discover [spoiler]Dinosaur[/spoiler].
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 1 more way to discover [spoiler]Field[/spoiler].
[b]CHANGE:[/b] Added 1 more way to discover [spoiler]Windmill[/spoiler].
[b]FIX:[/b] General improvements.
[b]FIX:[/b] Localization corrections.
